15529.text: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.

15530.text: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping.

15531.text: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.

15532.text: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.

15533.text: But thou, O LORD, shall endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.

15534.text: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.

15535.text: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.

15536.text: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.

15537.text: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.

15538.text: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.

15539.text: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.

15540.text: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;

15541.text: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;

15542.text: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

15543.text: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.

15544.text: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.

15545.text: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.

15546.text: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.

15547.text: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:

15548.text: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.

15549.text: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.

15550.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.

15551.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

15552.text: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;

15553.text: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

15554.text: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.

15555.text: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.

15556.text: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.

15557.text: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.

15558.text: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.

15559.text: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

15560.text: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.

15561.text: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

15562.text: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.

15563.text: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.

15564.text: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

15565.text: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.

15566.text: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children;

15567.text: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.

15568.text: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.

15569.text: Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.

15570.text: Bless ye the LORD, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.

15571.text: Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.

15572.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.

15573.text: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:

15574.text: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:

15575.text: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:

15576.text: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.

15577.text: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.

15578.text: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.

15579.text: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.

15580.text: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.

15581.text: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.

15582.text: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.

15583.text: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.

15584.text: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.

15585.text: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;

15586.text: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man's heart.

15587.text: The trees of the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

15588.text: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.

15589.text: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.

15590.text: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.

15591.text: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.

15592.text: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.

15593.text: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.

15594.text: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.

15595.text: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.

15596.text: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.

15597.text: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.

15598.text: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.

15599.text: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.

15600.text: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.

15601.text: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.

15602.text: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.

15603.text: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.

15604.text: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

15605.text: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.

15606.text: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.

15607.text: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

15608.text: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.

15609.text: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.

15610.text: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.

15611.text: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

15612.text: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.

15613.text: He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the earth.

15614.text: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.

15615.text: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;

15616.text: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:

15617.text: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:

15618.text: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.

15619.text: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;

15620.text: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;

15621.text: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

15622.text: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.

15623.text: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:

15624.text: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:

15625.text: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.

15626.text: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.

15627.text: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:

15628.text: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.

15629.text: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

15630.text: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.

15631.text: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.

15632.text: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.

15633.text: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

15634.text: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.

15635.text: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.

15636.text: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.

15637.text: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.

15638.text: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

15639.text: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.

15640.text: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,

15641.text: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.

15642.text: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.

15643.text: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.

15644.text: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.

15645.text: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.

15646.text: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

15647.text: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.

15648.text: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.

15649.text: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:

15650.text: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;

15651.text: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD.

15652.text: Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

15653.text: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD? who can shew forth all his praise?

15654.text: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.

15655.text: Remember me, O LORD, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;

15656.text: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.

15657.text: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

15658.text: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.

15659.text: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.

15660.text: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.

15661.text: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

15662.text: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.

15663.text: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.

15664.text: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:

15665.text: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.

15666.text: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.

15667.text: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the LORD.

15668.text: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan and covered the company of Abiram.

15669.text: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.

15670.text: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.

15671.text: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.

15672.text: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;

15673.text: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.

15674.text: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.

15675.text: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:

15676.text: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.

15677.text: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:

15678.text: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.

15679.text: They joined themselves also unto Baalpeor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

15680.text: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.

15681.text: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.

15682.text: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.

15683.text: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:

15684.text: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.

15685.text: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the LORD commanded them:

15686.text: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.

15687.text: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.

15688.text: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,

15689.text: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.

15690.text: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.

15691.text: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.

15692.text: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.

15693.text: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.

15694.text: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.

15695.text: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:

15696.text: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.

15697.text: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.

15698.text: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.

15699.text: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD.

15700.text: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

15701.text: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;

15702.text: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.

15703.text: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.

15704.text: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

15705.text: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

15706.text: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.

15707.text: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

15708.text: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.

15709.text: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;

15710.text: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:

15711.text: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.

15712.text: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

15713.text: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.

15714.text: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

15715.text: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.

15716.text: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.

15717.text: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.

15718.text: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.

15719.text: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.

15720.text: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

15721.text: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.

15722.text: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;

15723.text: These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.

15724.text: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.

15725.text: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.

15726.text: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wit's end.

15727.text: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.

15728.text: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.

15729.text: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.

15730.text: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

15731.text: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.

15732.text: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;

15733.text: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

15734.text: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.

15735.text: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;

15736.text: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.

15737.text: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

15738.text: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.

15739.text: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.

15740.text: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.

15741.text: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

15742.text: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.

15743.text: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.

15744.text: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

15745.text: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

15746.text: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.

15747.text: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;

15748.text: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.

15749.text: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

15750.text: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

15751.text: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.

15752.text: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

15753.text: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?

15754.text: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

15755.text: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

15756.text: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

15757.text: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.

15758.text: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

15759.text: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.

15760.text: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

15761.text: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.

15762.text: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.

15763.text: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.

15764.text: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

15765.text: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.

15766.text: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.

15767.text: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

15768.text: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

15769.text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

15770.text: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

15771.text: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.

15772.text: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.

15773.text: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

15774.text: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

15775.text: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

15776.text: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.

15777.text: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

15778.text: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

15779.text: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.

15780.text: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.

15781.text: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:

15782.text: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, LORD, hast done it.

15783.text: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.

15784.text: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.

15785.text: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

15786.text: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.

15787.text: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

15788.text: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

15789.text: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

15790.text: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

15791.text: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

15792.text: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.

15793.text: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.

15794.text: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.

15795.text: The works of the LORD are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

15796.text: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

15797.text: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.

15798.text: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.

15799.text: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.

15800.text: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.

15801.text: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.

15802.text: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.

15803.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.

15804.text: Praise ye the LORD. Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.

15805.text: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

15806.text: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

15807.text: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

15808.text: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.

15809.text: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

15810.text: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.

15811.text: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.

15812.text: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.

15813.text: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.

15814.text: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.

15815.text: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.

15816.text: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD's name is to be praised.

15817.text: The LORD is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.

15818.text: Who is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,

15819.text: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!

15820.text: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

15821.text: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

15822.text: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.

15823.text: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;

15824.text: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.

15825.text: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.

15826.text: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.

15827.text: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?

15828.text: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?

15829.text: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;

15830.text: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.

15831.text: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth's sake.

15832.text: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?

15833.text: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.

15834.text: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

15835.text: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:

15836.text: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:

15837.text: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.

15838.text: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.

15839.text: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.

15840.text: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.

15841.text: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.

15842.text: The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.

15843.text: He will bless them that fear the LORD, both small and great.

15844.text: The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children.

15845.text: Ye are blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.

15846.text: The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORD's: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.

15847.text: The dead praise not the LORD, neither any that go down into silence.

15848.text: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD.

15849.text: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.

15850.text: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.

15851.text: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

15852.text: Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.

15853.text: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.

15854.text: The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.

15855.text: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.

15856.text: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

15857.text: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

15858.text: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:

15859.text: I said in my haste, All men are liars.

15860.text: What shall I render unto the LORD for all his benefits toward me?

15861.text: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.

15862.text: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.

15863.text: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.

15864.text: O LORD, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.

15865.text: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.

15866.text: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.

15867.text: In the courts of the LORD's house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.

15868.text: O praise the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.

15869.text: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD.

15870.text: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.

15871.text: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

15872.text: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

15873.text: Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

15874.text: I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place.

15875.text: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?

15876.text: The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.

15877.text: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.

15878.text: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.

15879.text: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them.

15880.text: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

15881.text: They compassed me about like bees: they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

15882.text: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.

15883.text: The LORD is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

15884.text: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

15885.text: The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

15886.text: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD.

15887.text: The LORD hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.

15888.text: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the LORD:

15889.text: This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.

15890.text: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.

15891.text: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.

15892.text: This is the LORD's doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.

15893.text: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

15894.text: Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.

15895.text: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.

15896.text: God is the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.

15897.text: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.

15898.text: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

15899.text: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.

15900.text: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.

15901.text: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.

15902.text: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.

15903.text: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!

15904.text: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.

15905.text: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.

15906.text: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.

15907.text: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.

15908.text: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.

15909.text: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

15910.text: Blessed art thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.

15911.text: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.

15912.text: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.

15913.text: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.

15914.text: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.

15915.text: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.

15916.text: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.

15917.text: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.

15918.text: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.

15919.text: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.

15920.text: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.

15921.text: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.

15922.text: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.

15923.text: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.

15924.text: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.

15925.text: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.

15926.text: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.

15927.text: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.

15928.text: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.

15929.text: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.

15930.text: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.

15931.text: Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.

15932.text: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.

15933.text: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.

15934.text: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.

15935.text: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.

15936.text: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.

15937.text: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.

15938.text: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.

15939.text: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD, even thy salvation, according to thy word.

15940.text: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.

15941.text: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.

15942.text: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.

15943.text: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.

15944.text: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.

15945.text: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.

15946.text: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.

15947.text: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.

15948.text: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.

15949.text: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.

15950.text: I remembered thy judgments of old, O LORD; and have comforted myself.

15951.text: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

15952.text: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

15953.text: I have remembered thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept thy law.

15954.text: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.

15955.text: Thou art my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.

15956.text: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.

15957.text: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

15958.text: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.

15959.text: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.

15960.text: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.

15961.text: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.

15962.text: The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.

15963.text: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according unto thy word.

15964.text: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.

15965.text: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.

15966.text: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.

15967.text: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.

15968.text: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.

15969.text: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.

15970.text: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.

15971.text: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

15972.text: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.

15973.text: I know, O LORD, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.

15974.text: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.

15975.text: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.

15976.text: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.

15977.text: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.

15978.text: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.

15979.text: My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.

15980.text: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?

15981.text: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.

15982.text: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

15983.text: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.

15984.text: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.

15985.text: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.

15986.text: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.

15987.text: For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.

15988.text: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.

15989.text: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.

15990.text: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

15991.text: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.

15992.text: I am thine, save me: for I have sought thy precepts.

15993.text: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.

15994.text: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.

15995.text: O how I love thy law! it is my meditation all the day.

15996.text: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.

15997.text: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.

15998.text: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.

15999.text: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.

16000.text: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.

16001.text: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

16002.text: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.

16003.text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

16004.text: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.

16005.text: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD, according unto thy word.

16006.text: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.

16007.text: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.

16008.text: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.

16009.text: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.

16010.text: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.

16011.text: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.

16012.text: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

16013.text: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.

16014.text: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

16015.text: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.

16016.text: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.

16017.text: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.

16018.text: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.

16019.text: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.

16020.text: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.

16021.text: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.

16022.text: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.

16023.text: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.

16024.text: It is time for thee, LORD, to work: for they have made void thy law.

16025.text: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.

16026.text: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.

16027.text: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.

16028.text: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.

16029.text: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.

16030.text: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.

16031.text: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

16032.text: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.

16033.text: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.

16034.text: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.

16035.text: Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy judgments.

16036.text: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.

16037.text: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.

16038.text: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.

16039.text: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.

16040.text: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.

16041.text: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.

16042.text: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.

16043.text: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.

16044.text: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.

16045.text: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.

16046.text: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.

16047.text: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O LORD, quicken me according to thy judgment.

16048.text: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.

16049.text: Thou art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments are truth.

16050.text: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.

16051.text: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.

16052.text: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.

16053.text: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.

16054.text: Great are thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments.

16055.text: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.

16056.text: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.

16057.text: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.

16058.text: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.

16059.text: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.

16060.text: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.

16061.text: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.

16062.text: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.

16063.text: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.

16064.text: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.

16065.text: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.

16066.text: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.

16067.text: Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.

16068.text: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.

16069.text: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.

16070.text: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.

16071.text: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.

16072.text: I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law is my delight.

16073.text: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.

16074.text: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.

16075.text: In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.

16076.text: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.

16077.text: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?

16078.text: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

16079.text: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!

16080.text: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.

16081.text: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.

16082.text: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

16083.text: My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.

16084.text: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.

16085.text: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.

16086.text: The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.

16087.text: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.

16088.text: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.

16089.text: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

16090.text: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.

16091.text: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.

16092.text: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:

16093.text: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.

16094.text: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

16095.text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.

16096.text: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.

16097.text: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.

16098.text: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.

16099.text: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

16100.text: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.

16101.text: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

16102.text: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.

16103.text: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;

16104.text: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:

16105.text: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:

16106.text: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:

16107.text: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

16108.text: Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

16109.text: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.

16110.text: Our help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

16111.text: They that trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.

16112.text: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.

16113.text: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.

16114.text: Do good, O LORD, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.

16115.text: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.

16116.text: When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.

16117.text: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.

16118.text: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.

16119.text: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.

16120.text: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

16121.text: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.

16122.text: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.

16123.text: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.

16124.text: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.

16125.text: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.

16126.text: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.

16127.text: Blessed is every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.

16128.text: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

16129.text: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.

16130.text: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.

16131.text: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

16132.text: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Israel.

16133.text: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:

16134.text: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.

16135.text: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.

16136.text: The LORD is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

16137.text: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.

16138.text: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:

16139.text: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

16140.text: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD be upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.

16141.text: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.

16142.text: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.

16143.text: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?

16144.text: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.

16145.text: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.

16146.text: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.

16147.text: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.

16148.text: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.

16149.text: Lord, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.

16150.text: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.

16151.text: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.

16152.text: Lord, remember David, and all his afflictions:

16153.text: How he sware unto the LORD, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;

16154.text: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;

16155.text: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,

16156.text: Until I find out a place for the LORD, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.

16157.text: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.

16158.text: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.

16159.text: Arise, O LORD, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.

16160.text: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.

16161.text: For thy servant David's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.

16162.text: The LORD hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

16163.text: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.

16164.text: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.

16165.text: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

16166.text: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

16167.text: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

16168.text: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.

16169.text: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.

16170.text: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

16171.text: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;

16172.text: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.

16173.text: Behold, bless ye the LORD, all ye servants of the LORD, which by night stand in the house of the LORD.

16174.text: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.

16175.text: The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.

16176.text: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the name of the LORD; praise him, O ye servants of the LORD.

16177.text: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.

16178.text: Praise the LORD; for the LORD is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.

16179.text: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.

16180.text: For I know that the LORD is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.

16181.text: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.

16182.text: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.

16183.text: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.

16184.text: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.

16185.text: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;

16186.text: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:

16187.text: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.

16188.text: Thy name, O LORD, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.

16189.text: For the LORD will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.

16190.text: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

16191.text: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;

16192.text: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.

16193.text: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.

16194.text: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel: bless the LORD, O house of Aaron:

16195.text: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi: ye that fear the LORD, bless the LORD.

16196.text: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.

16197.text: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

16198.text: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever.

16199.text: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.

16200.text: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.

16201.text: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endureth for ever.

16202.text: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.

16203.text: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever:

16204.text: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:

16205.text: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.

16206.text: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever:

16207.text: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:

16208.text: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.

16209.text: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:

16210.text: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:

16211.text: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.

16212.text: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.

16213.text: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:

16214.text: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:

16215.text: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:

16216.text: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:

16217.text: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:

16218.text: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.

16219.text: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:

16220.text: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.

16221.text: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.

16222.text: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.

16223.text: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

16224.text: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.

16225.text: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.

16226.text: How shall we sing the LORD's song in a strange land?

16227.text: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.

16228.text: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.

16229.text: Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.

16230.text: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.

16231.text: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.

16232.text: I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.

16233.text: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.

16234.text: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.

16235.text: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD, when they hear the words of thy mouth.

16236.text: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD: for great is the glory of the LORD.

16237.text: Though the LORD be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.

16238.text: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.

16239.text: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.

16240.text: O lord, thou hast searched me, and known me.

16241.text: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.

16242.text: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.

16243.text: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O LORD, thou knowest it altogether.

16244.text: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.

16245.text: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.

16246.text: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

16247.text: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.

16248.text: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

16249.text: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.

16250.text: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.

16251.text: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.

16252.text: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother's womb.

16253.text: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

16254.text: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

16255.text: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.

16256.text: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!

16257.text: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.

16258.text: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.

16259.text: For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.

16260.text: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?

16261.text: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.

16262.text: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:

16263.text: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

16264.text: Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;

16265.text: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.

16266.text: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison is under their lips. Selah.

16267.text: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.

16268.text: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.

16269.text: I said unto the LORD, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.

16270.text: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.

16271.text: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.

16272.text: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

16273.text: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.

16274.text: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

16275.text: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.

16276.text: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.

16277.text: Lord, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.

16278.text: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.

16279.text: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

16280.text: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.

16281.text: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.

16282.text: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.

16283.text: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.

16284.text: But mine eyes are unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.

16285.text: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.

16286.text: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.

16287.text: I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.

16288.text: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.

16289.text: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.

16290.text: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.

16291.text: I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.

16292.text: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.

16293.text: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.

16294.text: Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.

16295.text: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.

16296.text: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.

16297.text: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.

16298.text: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.

16299.text: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.

16300.text: Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

16301.text: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.

16302.text: Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.

16303.text: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.

16304.text: Quicken me, O LORD, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.

16305.text: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.

16306.text: Blessed be the LORD my strength which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:

16307.text: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.

16308.text: LORD, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!

16309.text: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.

16310.text: Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

16311.text: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.

16312.text: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;

16313.text: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

16314.text: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.

16315.text: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.

16316.text: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:

16317.text: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:

16318.text: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:

16319.text: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.

16320.text: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the LORD.

16321.text: I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.

16322.text: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

16323.text: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.

16324.text: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.

16325.text: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.

16326.text: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.

16327.text: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.

16328.text: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.

16329.text: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

16330.text: All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD; and thy saints shall bless thee.

16331.text: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;

16332.text: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.

16333.text: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.

16334.text: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.

16335.text: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.

16336.text: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

16337.text: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.

16338.text: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.

16339.text: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.

16340.text: The LORD preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.

16341.text: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.

16342.text: Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.

16343.text: While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.

16344.text: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.

16345.text: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.

16346.text: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD his God:

16347.text: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth for ever:

16348.text: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners:

16349.text: The LORD openeth the eyes of the blind: the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down: the LORD loveth the righteous:

16350.text: The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.

16351.text: The LORD shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.

16352.text: Praise ye the LORD: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.

16353.text: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.

16354.text: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

16355.text: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.

16356.text: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.

16357.text: The LORD lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.
